summary: Fortress Credit Realty Income Trust filed an 8-K reporting the issuance and sale of 994,813 common shares across multiple classes (J-4, S, I, E, F-I, F-S) for gross proceeds of ~$20.0 million in an exempt transaction under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D and/or Regulation S. Shares were priced at NAV per share as of April 30, 2026. The filing also declared net distributions per class payable on June 1, 2026. No special situation is involved; this is a routine capital-raising and distribution announcement. There is no M&A, activist, strategic review, or restructuring event.
